title: Flip Fluid on Flip Dots
why_read: A niche but charming hardware/graphics hack simulating fluid dynamics on flip-dot displays.
analysis: This is likely a project applying fluid simulation (FLIP - Fluid Implicit Particle method) to flip-dot displays, an old mechanical display technology with black-and-white flipping tiles. It sits at the intersection of physics simulation and retro hardware, which tends to attract engineers interested in creative constraints. The technical interest is moderate since it's a fun demo rather than something with broad applicability, but flip-dot hacking projects are usually well documented and satisfying to read.
